name: SyncRanker Connector
author: Chandresh Pratap Singh

sections.description:
SyncRanker Connector is a lightweight WordPress plugin that establishes a secure bridge between your WordPress site and the SyncRanker AI SEO platform. Unlike manual integrations, this plugin provides an automated, one-click connection that leverages WordPress Application Passwords for secure API access.

Key Features:

  • One-Click Setup – No complex configuration or manual token generation needed
  • Secure Authentication – Uses WordPress Application Passwords for industry-standard security
  • System Health Checks – Automatically detects HTTPS requirements and Application Password availability
  • AI-Powered Content Publishing – Enable SyncRanker’s AI writers to publish directly to your site
  • Localized SEO Optimization – Support automated SEO improvements across multiple languages and locales
  • Page Building Integration – Facilitate AI-driven page generation and optimization

Once connected, your SyncRanker dashboard gains direct access to publish content, optimize pages, and manage SEO settings—all while your WordPress site maintains complete control and audit trails.

External services

This plugin connects to the SyncRanker SaaS platform (https://syncranker.com) to synchronize content and manage SEO campaigns from the cloud.

When an Administrator clicks the “Connect” button, the plugin securely sends the site URL and a newly generated Application Password to the SyncRanker app (https://app.syncranker.com) to establish an authorized connection. No personal user data, emails, or primary passwords are ever sent or tracked.

This service is provided by SyncRanker.
Terms of Service: https://syncranker.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://syncranker.com/privacy

Support

For support, feature requests, or to report bugs, please visit https://syncranker.com or check the plugin page on WordPress.org.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the Plugin

    • Go to your WordPress Admin Dashboard
    • Navigate to Plugins > Add New
    • Click “Upload Plugin” and select the syncranker-connector.zip file
    • Click “Install Now”

  2. Activate the Plugin

    • Locate “SyncRanker Connector” in your Plugins list
    • Click “Activate”

  3. Connect to SyncRanker

    • Go to the WordPress Admin Dashboard
    • Click “SyncRanker” in the left menu
    • Click the “🚀 Connect to SyncRanker” button
    • You’ll be redirected to SyncRanker to complete the connection
    • Once authorized, your site is ready for AI-powered automation

That’s it! Your WordPress site is now connected to SyncRanker.
sections.faq:
Is SyncRanker required to use this plugin?

Yes, you need an active SyncRanker account to use this plugin. The plugin itself only facilitates the connection. Visit https://syncranker.com to create an account or learn more.

How secure is the connection?

The plugin uses WordPress Application Passwords, which is the official WordPress security standard for third-party integrations. Passwords are encrypted and stored securely on your site. You can revoke access at any time from your WordPress user settings.

Will this plugin affect my site’s performance?

No, the plugin is lightweight and only adds a small admin page. It does not run any background processes or affect your site’s frontend performance.

What happens if I deactivate the plugin?

The connection will remain active until you manually revoke it. You can revoke the SyncRanker Application Password from your WordPress user settings under “Application Passwords” at any time.

What are the system requirements?

  • WordPress 5.6 or later
  • PHP 7.2 or later
  • HTTPS enabled (strongly recommended for security)
  • WordPress Application Passwords enabled (standard in most WordPress installations)

Can I use this plugin on a Multisite installation?

Currently, this plugin is designed for single-site WordPress installations. Multisite support may be added in future releases.

Do I need to configure anything else?

No additional configuration is needed. The plugin works out of the box once activated and connected.

What if I see a “Connection Impossible” message?

This typically means:
– Your hosting provider has disabled Application Passwords
– A security plugin is blocking the feature
– You’re running WordPress older than 5.6

Contact your hosting provider or security plugin author for assistance, or check the plugin page for troubleshooting steps.
